verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference provider, so embeddings and reranking are a fair axis to judge it on. Its docs list only the OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and speech-to-text APIs plus the Anthropic Messages API, with no mention of an embeddings or rerank endpoint. The RAG recipe and LangChain/LlamaIndex framework support are adjacent features and do not show first-party embedding or reranking capability.
